_comment: AOS Sprint 10 — Recruiter Intelligence Engine. Recruiter/consulting-contact knowledge base built by scanning real, already-existing data (demand-intelligence/opportunity-schema.json's Recruiter Channel/Consulting Channel entries, crm/company-intelligence.json's recruiter field and relationship data) — never a second, independently-collected source. Reuses CRM's own relationshipTemperature vocabulary rather than inventing a second one.

relationshipTemperatureScore._note: Converts CRM's own relationshipTemperature (hot/warm/cooling/cold) into a 0-100 number for sorting only — the label itself is CRM's, not recomputed here.

priorityWeights._note: Priority Recruiters ranking — a simple, documented weighted sum, not a hidden formula. relationshipStrength and responseRate/successRate are each 0-100 (missing values treated as 0, never guessed).

hiringDomainTags._note: Section filters — 'Recruiters hiring X' — matched against the domainTags already recorded on this contact's sourced opportunities, the same vocabulary every other AOS employee already uses.
